item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q015_artifact_tag_not_homology","answer":"In SCOPe 2.08, d1a14h2 is not a second immunoglobulin domain of chain H. It is the 8-residue N-terminal segment 1a14 H:1-8, classified as sunid 343393 with SCCS l.1.1.1 under class l, Artifacts: fold Tags, superfamily Tags, family Tags, protein N-terminal Tags, species Synthetic. By contrast, d1a14h1 is the real mouse immunoglobulin heavy-chain variable domain, classified as b.1.1.1.
